content_zh:
贝儿道：“姐妹们这个假期过了，我们真的就要回家族了吗？我爸爸昨天还让我拿这块玉佩出来呢，说是什么继承者的徽章，欲言又止的还以为咱们不知道这块玉佩的秘密，老爷子真是搞笑了，我感觉老爷子是知道这玉佩的意义，但是玉佩的秘密是真的不知道。”
贝儿从衣襟里面拉出一块通体碧玉的玉佩，玉佩倒是不大，掌心大小，娇嫩翠绿的颜色十分可人，看起来是有些年头的老宝贝了，上面是栩栩如生的莲花。
贝儿这么一说，艾米也诧异的拿出玉佩道：“我妈咪昨个也神神秘秘的叫我过去，说什么这块玉佩好好佩戴，结果我哥哥带着嫂子和侄子回来打断了，话就没说完。”
艾米的玉佩上面是一朵牡丹，和贝儿的样式是一样的，就是花样不同。
佳妮拽出来胸前的梅花玉佩道：“不会吧，昨个我爸爸也是将我叫到书房说了半天的话，难不成他们也发现了玉佩的秘密？这可是我们从小就佩戴的，怎么现在想起来了，不会有什么阴谋吧？是不是想让我们回去？”
艾米最为冷静的道：“不会，这玉佩是我们通过训练之后，各家的长老给的，我们选玉佩也是玉佩选我们，不过想起长老们的眼神，没准我们是捡到宝了。”
贝儿笑嘻嘻的道：“我估计啊，这个宝贝的内容是谁也弄不清楚的，我们也是意外发现的，不过这样好啊，那些不要脸的不就是想占我们的便宜，抢我们的东西吗？让他们统统做梦去吧，保管累死他们都找不着。”
佳妮还开玩笑的道：“哎姐妹们，那些别有居心的臭男人以后咱们都离远点，咱们也别回家族了，为别人卖命不合适，再说了，这玉佩的秘密只有我们三个知道，其他人一个字都不要说，也许哪一天我们就用这玉佩和玉佩的图样能找到彼此呢！”
贝儿和艾米听完愣了一下，贝儿道：“对，无论什么时候，我们都是彼此最好的姐妹和朋友！什么家族什么男人都不在我们的考虑范畴之内，无论什么情况下我们都能找到彼此。”
谁承想一语成戳的竟然成真了，事后每每想起这段，贝儿都想打自己几巴掌，真是没事说这些做什么！
几个人开开心心说着这个话题，忽然间机舱好似被什么东西碰撞了一般，很快飞机剧烈的摇晃起来，机舱内的东西都噼里啪啦的掉在了地板上，各种各样的碎片溅了一地。
贝儿的脸都被飞溅的碎片划了一个口子，佳妮也摔倒在地上，姿势有些狼狈。
最快缓过神的艾米看看窗外的战斗型的飞机，有六七架，有些飞机上的人还认识，这一帮败类刚刚一击未中，正在试图进行更激烈的攻击，艾米焦急的道：“不好我们被攻击了！”
艾米跌跌撞撞的滚着回到了驾驶舱，限的，这样高智能的飞机一般最多只有六发炮弹，杀伤力虽然强，但是对强大的对手就吃亏了。
其他的机枪弹还是有些的，但是只适合近距离的攻击，艾米看着外面几个飞机上的人，一脸的恨意浮现在脸上，好很好，她们三个家族的败类来了不少，为了能弄死她们不能回家族，还真是不遗余力了。
艾米一边冷静的分析形势，一边喊道：“贝儿将集团的股票立刻卖掉，将资金全部打入我们父母的账户，其余的钱全部转入希望基金会，我们就是那钱做慈善也不能便宜了这些人。”
贝儿也休想占到一分一厘的便宜，并且，心知这回难道此劫！
同时贝儿将飞机外面那些败类的截图也照了下来，立刻传输到了各家长老和族长那里，这么紧急的时候，也只有贝儿还记得这事了！
贝儿的想法就是我们今个就算是完蛋了，你们也休想得到任何好处，不管这些人渣有没有命活下来，他们的家人都等着接受各家族老和长老的怒火吧！

content_en:
Belle said: "Sisters, this holiday is over, are we really going back to the family? My father asked me to bring out this jade pendant yesterday, saying it was some kind of heir's emblem. He hesitated and thought we didn't know the secret of this jade pendant. The old man is really funny. I feel that the old man knows the meaning of this jade pendant, but he really doesn't know the secret of the jade pendant."
Belle pulled out a jade pendant made of pure jasper from the lapel of her clothes. The jade pendant was not big, about the size of a palm, and the delicate emerald green color was very pleasant. It looked like an old treasure. It had a lifelike lotus flower on it.
When Belle said this, Amy also took out the jade pendant in surprise and said: "My mommy also mysteriously called me over yesterday, saying that this jade pendant should be worn well, but my brother came back with his sister-in-law and nephew and interrupted, and the words were not finished."
Amy's jade pendant has a peony on it, which is the same style as Belle's, but the pattern is different.
Jiani pulled out the plum blossom jade pendant on her chest and said, "No way. Yesterday, my father also called me to the study and talked for a long time. Could it be that they also discovered the secret of the jade pendant? We have been wearing it since we were young. Why do we think about it now? Is there any conspiracy? Do you want us to go back?"
Amy said calmly: "No, this jade pendant was given to us by the elders of each family after we passed the training. We chose the jade pendant because the jade pendant chose us. But thinking about the looks in the elders' eyes, maybe we have found a treasure."
Belle said with a smile: "I guess no one can figure out the contents of this treasure. We also discovered it by accident, but that's good. Don't those shameless people just want to take advantage of us and steal our things? Let them all just dream. They will be exhausted from keeping it and they won't be able to find it."
Jiani also jokingly said: "Hey sisters, let's stay away from those stinky men with ulterior motives from now on, and let's not go back to the family. It's not appropriate to sacrifice our lives for others. Besides, only the three of us know the secret of this jade pendant, and the others shouldn't say a word. Maybe one day we can find each other using this jade pendant and its pattern!"
Belle and Amy were stunned for a moment after hearing this. Belle said, "Yes, we are each other's best sisters and friends at all times! No family or man is within our scope of consideration. We can find each other no matter what the situation."
Who would have thought that such a hit-and-miss statement actually came true. Every time she thought about this episode afterwards, Belle wanted to slap herself a few times. She really had nothing to do with what she said!
Several people were talking happily about this topic. Suddenly, the cabin seemed to be hit by something. Soon the plane shook violently, and everything in the cabin fell to the floor with all kinds of debris.
Belle's face was cut open by flying debris, and Jia Ni also fell to the ground in a somewhat awkward posture.
Amy, who was the quickest to recover, looked at the combat aircraft outside the window. There were six or seven of them. Some of the people on the planes knew each other. These scum had just missed a hit and were trying to launch a more intense attack. Amy said anxiously: "No, we are being attacked!"
Amy stumbled and rolled back to the cockpit. However, such a highly intelligent aircraft generally only has six rounds at most. Although it has strong lethality, it will suffer a loss against powerful opponents.
There were still some other machine gun bullets, but they were only suitable for close-range attacks. Amy looked at the people on the plane outside, with a look of hatred on her face. "Okay, okay, there are a lot of scum from the three families. In order to kill them and prevent them from returning to the family, they really spared no effort."
While analyzing the situation calmly, Amy shouted: "Belle, sell the group's stocks immediately, transfer all the funds to our parents' accounts, and transfer all the remaining money to the Hope Foundation. Even with that money, we can't do charity."Cheap these people. "
Belle couldn't even hope to take advantage of it, and she knew it was going to be a disaster this time!
At the same time, Belle also took screenshots of the scum outside the plane and immediately transmitted them to the elders and clan leaders. In such an emergency, only Belle still remembered this!
Belle's idea is that even if we are finished today, you can't expect any benefits. No matter whether these scum survive or not, their families are waiting to accept the wrath of the elders of each family!
